lines: IBKR exhibits ACCELERATING growth across all key metrics. Revenue grew at a 21.8% CAGR from 2021 to 2025 — driven by interest income on $780B in client equity and fee-compression-proof volume growth. The 79% pretax margin is the highest in the broker-dealer sector and a direct consequence of the proprietary, automated architecture. Most critically, 2025 delivered a record 1 million net new accounts — validating that the platform's scale advantage compounds with each new client.

narrative.issue_register_md: This section documents regulatory enforcement actions, supervisory findings, and material incidents that impact capability scores through the assessment's scoring methodology. All items listed have been confirmed from primary source T1 evidence (FINRA AWC documents, SEC enforcement orders, CFTC orders, state AG filings). IBKR has accumulated ~$62M+ (10 enforcement actions/incidents, 2020-2025) across the period 2020-2025, representing the most material compliance headwind in this assessment cohort. Each enforcement action is mapped to the specific capabilities it caps and the maturity ceiling that applies. The pattern finding — confirmed by multiple independent regulators — is 'automation-without-governance scope': IBKR deploys automation at extraordinary scale, but each AWC identifies a specific domain where automated processes lacked adequate scope, coverage, or supervisory oversight.
